items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 11 at 11:07AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Rampart and Tanana.

The Yukon River breakup front is currently downstream of Rampart.

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued May 11 at 9:15AM AKDT until May 11 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* AFFECTED AREA...Delta Junction.

* TIMING...10 AM to 10 PM AKDT today.

* WINDS...South 15 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* HUMIDITY...As low as 20 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...Highs in the upper 50s.

* IMPACTS...Critical fire weather conditions are expected today
due to a combination of low relative humidity, gusty winds,
and dry fuels. Any new fire starts or existing fires may spread
rapidly.
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Blizzard Warning issued May 10 at 5:43PM AKDT until May 11 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Blowing snow. Winds gusting as high as 40 mph.

* WHERE...Point Lay.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility to a quarter mile or less at times.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...No falling snow is expected. The blowing snow
is low to the ground.
items.instruction:
Travel should be restricted to emergencies only. If you must travel,
have a winter survival kit with you. If you get stranded, stay with
your vehicle.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 10 at 9:40AM AKDT until May 11 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Delta Junction.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 10 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low relative humidity and gusty winds
combined with dry fuels will lead to critical fire weather
conditions, particularly Sunday afternoon and Monday afternoon.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
